blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Astra等前沿多模式语言代理已经表现出强大的能力,可以直接通过没有高层次原始物的低层次数字动作控制机器人. 然而,现有基准只报告各集的成功率,这些成功率既没有显示这些代理人如何成功,也没有显示他们在哪里失败。 在本文中,我们提出了对边界人员在12个操纵基准上进行直接机器人控制的系统行动分析。 我们介绍RoboCritic探员,这是一个基于意图的批评框架,在这个框架里,政策代理人在每项行动的同时陈述了当地的意图,一名批评者根据这一意图评价行动的结果和失败模式。 我们的行动层面分析表明,前沿人员在直接机器人控制方面有希望的能力,包括从局部执行失败中进行闭路回收,在各种场景中进行可靠的语义定位,在没有针对特定任务的调整的情况下进行强烈的零射操纵。 报告也查明了目前存在的局限性,包括与任务有关的实际执行瓶颈,例如把握和调整,以及不同失败模式的复苏不平衡。 最后,我们用400个行动人类附加基准验证我们的批评家,并发布12,844个附加说明动作的数据集,同时发布微调开放源码评论家Muse-Glimer-30B,其故障模式精度从32.58%上升到74.24%,从而能够进行低成本的行动层面分析.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in robot foundation models follow two main paradigms: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), which adapt Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to output low-level robot actions, and World-Action Models (WAMs), which build upon video-generation world models. Despite building upon existing foundation models, both families still suffer from brittle out-of-distribution generalization [ 15 , 56 , 44 ] and limited long-horizon memory [ 12 , 39 ] . Moreover, deploying VLAs and WAMs to new downstream tasks typically requires task-specific fine-tuning [ 21 , 6 , 35 , 50 ] , limiting their zero-shot adaptation.
blocks.zh: 机器人基础模型的近期进展遵循两个主要范式:Vision-Language-Action模型(VLAs),它使Vision-Language Models(VLMs)能够输出低级机器人动作;World-Action Models(WAMs),它建立在视频生成世界模型上. 尽管以现有的基础模式为基础,但两个家庭仍然遭受着简便的分散化[15、56、44]和有限的长距离记忆[12、39]。 此外,将VLA和WAM部署到新的下游任务中,通常需要针对特定任务进行微调[21,6,35,50],限制其零镜头适应.

blocks.en: Beyond these two paradigms, frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra [ 34 ] offer a promising alternative: they control robots directly via low-level numerical actions without relying on high-level primitives, show strong zero-shot generalization and working memory in robotic manipulation [ 55 , 20 , 22 , 18 ] , and outperform specialized VLAs and WAMs [ 55 , 20 , 47 ] . These results demonstrate the vast potential of leveraging frontier language model agents directly as generalist robot policies.
blocks.zh: 在这两种范式之外,前沿多模式语言代理人如GPT-6 Astra[34] 提供了一个很有希望的替代方案:他们直接通过低水平的数字动作控制机器人,而不依赖高水平原始人,在机器人操纵中表现出强烈的零射一般化和工作记忆[55,20,22,18],并且超越专业VLA和WAM[55,20,47]. 这些结果表明,直接利用前沿语言模型代理人作为通用机器人政策的巨大潜力。

blocks.en: Existing evaluations assess these agents at the episode level , with binary success rates or aggregate task scores that show neither how an agent succeeds nor where it fails. In this paper, we provide a systematic, fine-grained investigation into the capabilities and limitations of frontier agents on direct robot control by analyzing their behavior at the action level . Evaluating an individual action can be ambiguous because robot manipulation is inherently multimodal [ 16 , 38 , 10 ] : since multiple distinct trajectories can validly advance the same task, whether an action succeeds depends on its intended sub-goal. We resolve this ambiguity by letting the policy agent state a local intent alongside each action, establishing a verifiable local contract for every action (Figure 1 (a)). Conditioned on the global task goal, this local intent, and multi-view observations, our AgentRoboCritic framework determines whether each executed action succeeded and assigns a specific failure mode to every failed action. Using GPT-6 Astra as the critic, we annotate episodes across 12 robot manipulation benchmarks for further analysis.
blocks.zh: 现有评价在剧集层面评估这些代理人,二进制成功率或总任务分数既不显示代理人如何成功,也不显示其失败之处. 在本文中,我们通过分析其行动层面的行为,对前沿特工在直接机器人控制方面的能力和局限性进行系统、细致的调查。 评估单个行动可能是模棱两可的,因为机器人操纵本身是多式联运[16、38、10]:由于多种不同的轨迹可以有效推进同一任务,因此某项行动是否成功取决于其预期的次级目标。 我们通过让政策代理人在每项行动的同时说明地方意图,为每项行动制定可核查的地方合同来解决这一模糊问题(图1(a))。 基于全球任务目标,这个局部意图,以及多视图观察,我们的AgentRoboCritic框架决定每个执行的行动是否成功,并为每个失败的行动指定一个特定的失败模式. 以GPT-6 Astra为评论者,我们用12个机器人操纵基准来注释事件,以便进一步分析.

blocks.en: Our analysis characterizes both the promising capabilities and the current limitations of frontier agents on direct robot control. On the capability side, frontier agents show three major strengths (Figure 1 (b)). First, they recover from local execution failures in closed loop, unlike imitation-trained policies whose errors compound under covariate shift [ 37 ] , and half of their successful episodes contain at least one failed action that the agent later corrects. Second, they show reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, executing actions that follow the target object, category, and sequential order specified in the local intent. Third, they achieve strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. On the limitation side, frontier agents face task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks, led by object acquisition and retention ( Grasp ) in general manipulation, spatial mating ( Alignment ) in tight-tolerance visuo-tactile tasks, and unintended collisions ( Interference ) in cluttered scenes. Recovery is also uneven across failure modes: Alignment failures are recovered less often than Grasp failures.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析既说明有希望的能力,也说明边界人员目前对直接机器人控制的限制。 在能力方面,边防人员有三大优势(图1(b))。 首先,他们从密闭循环的本地执行失败中恢复过来,与仿真训练的政策不同,后者的错误在共变移[37] 下复合,他们成功的事件有一半包含至少一个失败的动作,由代理商后来纠正. 第二,它们显示可靠的语义定位,跨越不同的场景,执行按照目标对象,类别,以及当地意图中规定的顺序进行的行动. 第三,它们实现强烈的零射操纵,而不进行特定任务调整. 在限制方面,边境代理人面临与任务相关的实际执行瓶颈,主要有:一般操纵中的物体获取和保留(Grasp),对活动任务进行严格容忍的空间交配(对齐),以及杂交场景中的意外碰撞(干扰)。 不同故障模式的恢复也不平衡: 对齐失败的回收次数比Grasp失败少.

blocks.en: To validate the reliability of our automated annotations, we construct a 400-action human-annotated evaluation benchmark and demonstrate that GPT-6 Astra aligns closely with human judgments, while ablating local intent causes a sharp collapse in failure-mode attribution. Finally, to enable low-cost action-level critique for direct robot control, we curate an open-source dataset of 12,844 annotated actions and fine-tune an open-source critic VLM, Muse-Glimmer-30B, which approaches GPT-6 Astra on both action outcome and failure-mode accuracy (Figure 1 (c)).
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们自动说明的可靠性,我们构建了一个400行动的人为附加说明的评价基准,并表明GPT-6 Astra与人类判断密切配合,而本地意图的破坏则会导致故障模式归属的急剧崩溃. 最后,为了能够对直接机器人控制进行低成本的动作层面的批评,我们整理了12,844个带注释动作的开源数据集,并对开源评论员VLM,Muse-Glimer-30B进行微调,在动作结果和故障模式准确性上接近GPT-6 Astra(图1(c))。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows: • Intent-Grounded Action Critique Framework: We propose AgentRoboCritic , a framework that evaluates frontier language model agents on direct robot control at the action level by conditioning the critique on both global task objectives and the policy’s local intent. • Action-Level Analysis of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control: We go beyond episode-level success rates to establish frontier agents as a promising path toward generalist robot policies and to identify the physical execution bottlenecks that remain. • Open-Source Critique Dataset and Critic VLM: We curate and release an action-level critique dataset alongside a 400-action human-annotated test set, as well as a fine-tuned Muse-Glimmer-30B critic VLM that enables accurate, low-cost failure analysis.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Language models have been connected to robots through planning over pretrained skills [ 19 ] .
Code-as-policy approaches generate programs that call perception and control APIs [ 23 , 41 , 17 ] .
Both lines of work delegate execution to skills and control primitives.
Recent studies investigate frontier multimodal language agents that generate numerical actions directly from observations [ 55 , 18 , 22 , 20 ] .
We explore the potential of frontier agents in direct robot control, which reflects their intrinsic embodied abilities disentangled from those of the primitives.
blocks.zh:
语言模型通过规划超前训练技能与机器人相连[19].
守则-政策办法产生要求认知和控制API[23、41、17]的程序。
这两行工作将执行委托给技能和控制原始人。
最近的研究调查了直接从观测结果中产生数字行动的前沿多式联运代理人[55、18、22、20]。
我们探索前沿特工在直接机器人控制中的潜力,这反映了他们与原始人的能力脱节的固有能力。

blocks.en:
A growing set of studies measures frontier agents acting as the robot policy.
Reports on GPT-6 Astra score it against public policies on all 42 RoboDojo tasks [ 8 , 55 ] , on the memory-dependent tasks of RoboMME [ 12 , 20 ] , on the simulated RoboLab-120 pick-and-place suite [ 48 ] , on real bimanual desk tasks [ 36 ] , and on visuo-tactile UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks [ 47 ] .
Cross-model studies run several frontier models through one shared harness, across the four RoboColiseum tracks [ 18 ] and on physical arms for six RoboDojo tasks, where capability is tracked over time [ 22 ] .
GPT-GEAR probes depth, in-context learning and tactile use, then scores GPT-6 Astra on five established benchmarks and a new geometry-constrained suite [ 57 ] .
The open harness Embodied First Exam [ 43 ] exposes hundreds of simulated tasks to coding agents and verifies outcomes independently of what the agent reports.
These evaluations assess behavior at the episode level via binary success rates or aggregate progress scores. AgentRoboCritic instead judges each action against the local intent, providing fine-grained and well-posed feedback.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的研究衡量前沿特工作为机器人政策。
关于GPT-6 Astra的所有42个RoboDojo任务[8,55],RoboMME的内存依赖任务[12,20],模拟的RoboLab-120挑档套房[48],真实的双人办公桌任务[36],以及粘着操作的UniVTAC和OpenViTac任务[47],均与公共政策对照得分.
跨模型研究通过一个共用的牵引装置运行着几个前沿模型,跨越四个RoboColiseum轨道[18],在物理臂上运行着六个RoboDojo任务,在时间上跟踪能力[22].
GPT-GEAR探测器深度,内文学习和触觉使用,然后根据5个既定基准和一个新的几何约束套件对GPT-6 Astra进行评分[57].
开放式的Embody First Exam [43] 暴露出数百项模拟任务用于编码代理,并独立于代理报告的结果进行验证.
这些评价通过二进制成功率或总进度分数来评价剧集层面的行为. 相反,RoboCritic探员对反对当地意图的每一项行动都作出判断,提供了精细的反馈。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: To systematically understand the capabilities and current limitations of frontier agents in physical manipulation, we first formulate the paradigm of direct robot control (Section 3.1 ) and then introduce AgentRoboCritic , our intent-grounded failure attribution framework that diagnoses agent execution at the granularity of individual actions (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了系统地了解边境特工在实际操纵方面的能力和目前的局限性,我们首先制定了直接机器人控制(第3.1节)的范式,然后引入了基于意图的故障归属框架RoboCritic(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
blocks.zh: 3.1 直接机器人控制的边境代理人

blocks.en: While direct robot control allows frontier agents to solve complex manipulation tasks zero-shot, standard episode-level success rates obscure how individual actions succeed or fail during closed-loop execution. Figure 2 illustrates the overall pipeline of AgentRoboCritic . Below, we formulate intent-grounded action critique, then describe trajectory collection, failure attribution and the human-annotated benchmark.
blocks.zh: 虽然直接机器人控制可以让边疆特工解决复杂的操纵任务零镜头,但标准插曲级别的成功率却模糊了个人动作在闭路执行过程中的成败. 图2显示RoboCritic剂的整个管道。 下面,我们提出基于意图的行动批评,然后描述轨迹收集、失败归属和人类附加说明的基准。

blocks.en:
Task Formulation. Critiquing an isolated robotic action a t a_{t} solely against the global task instruction G G is ill-posed because robotic manipulation is inherently multimodal, allowing many distinct trajectories to validly advance the same overarching goal. blocks.en: Intent-Grounded Trajectory Collection. Standard robot evaluation rollouts typically log only low-level states and actions without action-level local intents, and retrofitting end-to-end VLAs or WAMs to articulate reliable sub-goals at every control step is non-trivial [ 53 , 40 ] . Frontier agents, in contrast, already act through structured tool calls. We extend each tool call with a mandatory note parameter in which the agent states the local intent g t g_{t} of each commanded action a t a_{t} (Equation ( 2 )). Any tool call that omits this local intent parameter is automatically rejected by the execution harness, prompting the agent to reissue a properly grounded command. Beyond live rollouts, we also curate released evaluation trajectories from open benchmarks where action-level decision notes and synchronized visual observations were natively logged [ 8 , 36 , 47 ] .

Intent-Grounded Critique and Failure Attribution. Given each action record ( G , g t , 𝒪 t ) (G,g_{t},\mathcal{O}_{t}) , we employ GPT-6 Astra as an automated action-level critic to generate structured annotations ( y ^ t , m ^ t , e ^ t ) (\hat{y}_{t},\hat{m}_{t},\hat{e}_{t}) . To ensure physical rigor and prevent hallucinated causes, our annotation protocol enforces three core design principles:
(1) Contact-aware temporal windows: Evaluating whether an action achieved its local intent requires matching the observation window to the physical semantics of g t g_{t} . While reaching and alignment steps can be judged from action-boundary frames ( O t pre , O t post ) (O_{t}^{\text{pre}},O_{t}^{\text{post}}) , gripper-closing actions require evidence of stable capture and retention, which we provide via immediate post-grasp lift frames O t aux O_{t}^{\text{aux}} .
(2) Decoupling local validity from episode outcomes: An action is judged strictly against its local intent g t g_{t} and visible physical transition. An early failed grasp that the agent subsequently recovers from is still labeled as an action-level failure. Conversely, a deliberate diagnostic test (e.g., slightly loosening the gripper to test stability) or an intentionally small intermediate adjustment is labeled Achieved when it fulfills g t g_{t} .
(3) Evidence-bounded failure attribution: For every action judged as Failed , the critic classifies the failure into one of the seven failure modes illustrated in Figure 3 ( Grasp , Alignment , Interference , Effect , Incomplete motion , Choice , or Unresolved ) and writes a concise diagnostic note e ^ t \hat{e}_{t} specifying the active arm, target object, contact geometry, and observed failure timing. More details are provided in Appendix A .

We design our experimental evaluation to systematically characterize both the capabilities and the current limitations of frontier agents in direct robot control.
We assemble an evaluation suite of GPT-6 Astra rollouts in direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks: RoboDojo [ 8 ] , StationeryBench [ 36 ] , Astranomy [ 48 ] , UniVTAC [ 7 ] , OpenViTac [ 45 ] , ContactBench 1.0 [ 46 ] , LIBERO-MAX [ 56 ] , Meta-World+ [ 26 ] , DexJoCo [ 42 ] , RoboWits [ 24 ] , RoboTwin 2.0 [ 9 ] , and YAMLab [ 5 ] . We then analyze this collection with our AgentRoboCritic framework. We verify the reliability of its critic against human annotations in Section 5 .

For seven benchmarks ( LIBERO-MAX , Meta-World+ , DexJoCo , RoboWits , RoboTwin 2.0 , YAMLab , and ContactBench 1.0 ), we collect new GPT-6 Astra episodes, requiring a local intent alongside every action and recording camera observations at action boundaries. We compare frontier agents against representative VLAs and WAMs, including π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 35 ] and InternW0- Δ \Delta [ 27 ] , under the same zero-shot setting without task-specific fine-tuning. More implementation details are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.1 Capabilities and Promise of Frontier Agents
blocks.zh: 4.1 边境代理人的能力和承诺

blocks.en: We first examine what frontier agents already do well in direct robot control and why this paradigm holds strong promise for generalist manipulation. Figure 4 summarizes the action-level failure distributions across all evaluated benchmarks, revealing that while failure patterns vary with task structure and concentrate primarily in low-level physical grasping ( Grasp ), semantic selection errors ( Choice ) remain remarkably rare. Building on our action-level critique and zero-shot policy evaluations, we highlight three core strengths of frontier agents: closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查在直接机器人控制方面哪些前沿特工已经做得很好,为什么这种范式对一般主义操纵有很强的希望。 图4总结了在所有评估基准中的行动层面失败分布,显示失败模式因任务结构而异,主要集中于低水平的物理把握(Grasp),语义选择错误(Choice)仍然非常罕见。 在行动层面的批评和零镜头政策评价的基础上,我们强调前沿机构的三个核心优势:从当地执行失败中恢复闭路性;在各种场景中可靠地语义定位;在没有具体任务调整的情况下进行有力的零镜头操纵。

blocks.en: Closed-Loop Recovery from Local Execution Failures. A classic bottleneck of imitation-trained robot policies is covariate shift [ 37 ] , where a single execution error pushes the robot outside the demonstration distribution and subsequent errors compound until the episode fails. Our action-level annotations reveal that frontier agents in direct control behave differently, recovering from local failures and still completing the task. As shown in Figure 5 (a), 49.8% of all successful episodes contain at least one local failure, showing that half of the successes are reached through recovery. Episodes with one or two local failures still succeed in 40.3% of cases, compared to 75.1% for failure-free episodes (Figure 5 (b)), indicating that frontier agents complete a substantial share of tasks despite local failures. These results show that frontier agents tolerate and correct their own execution errors.
blocks.zh: 本地执行失败的闭环回收。 模仿训练机器人政策的经典瓶颈是共变变换[37],其中一次执行错误将机器人推到演示分发之外,随后的错误复合到插曲失败. 我们的行动说明显示,直接控制的边境人员行为不同,从当地的失败中恢复过来,仍然完成任务。 如图5(a)所示,49.8%的成功事件至少包含一次局部失败,表明一半的成功是通过恢复实现的。 本地有一两个故障的集在40.3%的案例中仍然成功,而无故障的集在75.1%(图5(b)),这表明尽管本地有故障,边境特工还是完成了相当一部分任务. 这些结果表明,边防人员容忍并纠正了自己的执行错误。

blocks.en: We further quantify the failure recovery dynamics of frontier agents on direct robot control. We analyze failed actions across the 12 benchmarks and count a failure as recovered when a subsequent action in the same episode verifiably resolves it, such as a regrasp after which the object rises with the gripper. In Figure 5 (c), 38.9% of the analyzed failures are recovered within 10 actions and 57.7% by the end of the episode, showing that frontier agents resolve more than half of their own failures. Figure 5 (d) further shows that benchmarks with a higher recovery rate also reach a higher official success rate among the episodes that contain a local failure, with a Pearson correlation of 0.81, indicating that failure recovery is closely associated with task success in direct robot control. This demonstrates that frontier agents can act as closed-loop policies with promising failure recovery ability (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们进一步量化直接机器人控制的边境特工的故障恢复动态。 我们分析12个基准的失败行动,并将同一集中随后的行动以可核查的方式解决的失败算作恢复的失败,例如重塑,然后物体随夹子上升。 在图5(c)中,38.9%的经分析的失败在10项行动中被追回,57.7%在剧情结束时被追回,这表明边境特工解决了自己一半以上的失败. 图5(d)进一步显示,回收率较高的基准在含有局部故障的事故中也达到了较高的官方成功率,皮尔逊相关数据为0.81,表明故障回收与任务成功直接机器人控制密切相关. 这表明,边境人员可以采取封闭式逃逸政策,有希望回收故障(附录C)。

blocks.en: Reliable Semantic Grounding Across Diverse Scenes. Specialized VLAs and WAMs remain vulnerable to visual perturbations, camera shifts, and spatial rearrangements, often suffering steep performance drops on robustness suites such as LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-MAX, and VLATest [ 15 , 56 , 44 ] . Our action-level critique highlights a clear contrast for frontier agents. A failed action is labeled Choice when its execution contradicts the object, order or category stated in the local intent. As shown in Figure 4 , Choice accounts for 0.2% of all failed actions across the 12 benchmarks and for at most 3.3% on any single benchmark. Even when confronted with novel object instances and visual distractors, frontier agents act on the object, order and category stated in their local intent, demonstrating reliable semantic grounding in direct robot control.
blocks.zh: 可靠的语义定位 跨越不同的场景。 专门的VLA和WAM仍然容易受到视觉扰动,相机转向和空间重排的伤害,经常在LIBERO-Plus,LIBERO-MAX,VLA Testival等稳健性套房上遭受剧烈性能下降[15,56,44]. 我们的行动层面的批评凸显了边境人员之间的明显对比。 失败的动作, 当执行时与本地意图中声明的对象, 命令或类别相矛盾时, 被标记为选择 。 如图4所示,在12项基准中,选择占所有失败行动的0.2%,在任何单一基准中,选择最多占3.3%。 即使是面对新事物事件和视觉分散器,边疆特工也会根据本地意向中所述的物体,秩序和类别行事,表明可靠的语义定位在直接机器人控制中.

blocks.en: Strong Zero-Shot Manipulation. Achieving zero-shot generalization to unseen manipulation tasks and environments without in-domain demonstrations or task-specific adaptation has been a long-standing goal in robot learning [ 31 , 60 , 30 , 6 ] . However, existing VLAs and WAMs, including recent generalist policies such as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 35 ] , typically struggle when deployed zero-shot outside their training distribution and require task-specific fine-tuning to achieve reliable control. As shown in Figure 6 , frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra achieve strong zero-shot success rates across diverse manipulation benchmarks directly out of the box, substantially outperforming unadapted VLA and WAM baselines. Moreover, frontier agents achieve this manipulation capability while preserving their general-purpose language reasoning and multimodal understanding within a single unified model. By contrast, training or adapting VLAs on domain-specific robot trajectories frequently degrades the pretrained VLM backbone’s general visuo-linguistic reasoning and conversational capabilities [ 59 , 58 , 49 ] .
blocks.zh: 强力零射操纵. 在机器人学习方面,实现零射一般化,不进行域内演示或针对特定任务进行改造,实现无形的操纵任务和环境,是长期的目标[31、60、30、6]。 然而,现有的VLA和WAM,包括最近的通论政策,如 π 0.5\pi_{0.5}[35],一般在训练分配之外部署零射时会挣扎,需要针对特定任务进行微调,以实现可靠的控制. 如图6所示,GPT-6 Astra等前沿多模式语言代理人直接从方框中取出各种操纵基准,实现强劲的零射成功率,大大超过未适应的VLA和WAM基线。 此外,边境代理人在获得这种操纵能力的同时,在单一的统一模式下保留其通用语言推理和多式联运理解。 相比之下,对特定领域机器人轨迹的VLA进行训练或调整,往往会降低预先训练的VLM主干的一般比语推理和对话能力[59、58、49]。

blocks.en: 4.2 Current Limitations of Frontier Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2 目前对边境代理人的限制

blocks.en: Task-Relevant Physical Execution Bottlenecks. Despite these capabilities, frontier agents still face task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks. As shown in Figure 4 , action-level failure modes are concentrated in low-level physical interaction and shift systematically with task geometry. In general tabletop and bimanual manipulation, object acquisition and retention ( Grasp ) is the primary bottleneck and the most frequent failure mode on nine of the ten non-tactile benchmarks. When the task setting moves to tight-tolerance assembly and insertion on the vision-only visuo-tactile benchmarks ( UniVTAC and OpenViTac ), the primary bottleneck shifts sharply from Grasp to Alignment , as the agent reliably grasps the connector or block and approaches the target receptacle, but struggles to resolve millimeter-scale mating tolerances and angular alignment from vision alone. Meanwhile, benchmarks with dense object clutter or multi-stage rearrangement (such as RoboDojo-Generalization , RoboDojo-Memory , RoboDojo-Long-horizon , and Meta-World+ ) exhibit a marked rise in Interference due to unintended collisions during transit, whereas LIBERO-MAX and StationeryBench exhibit a high share of Incomplete motion from prematurely terminated reaches or incomplete releases.
blocks.zh: 任务相关物理执行 Bottlenecks. 尽管有这些能力,边境人员仍然面临与任务有关的实际执行瓶颈。 如图4所示,动作级故障模式集中在低级物理交互上,并与任务几何系统转移. 在一般的桌面和双人操纵中,对象获取和保留(Grasp)是十种非激活基准中九种的主要瓶颈和最频繁的失败模式. 当任务设定转向紧紧的容忍组装并插入仅视距比对活性基准(UnivTAC和OpenViTac)时,主要瓶颈从Grasp急剧转向对齐,因为物剂可靠地抓住连接器或挡住并接近目标贮器,但努力从单视角度解决毫米的交配容和角对齐. 与此同时,由于在过境期间发生意外碰撞,具有密集物体杂交或多级重排的基准(如RoboDojo-generation、RoboDojo-Memory、RoboDojo-Long-horizon和Meta-World+)显示干扰明显增加,而LIBERO-MAX和Statery Bench则显示,过早终止或未完全释放的不完全运动占很大比例。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Recovery by failure mode and Grasp sub-categories. (a) Share of failed actions with a verified recovery by the end of the episode. (b) Share of each sub-category among all Grasp failures across the 12 benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 图7:按故障模式和Grasp子类别分列的回收情况。 (a) 在剧集结束前经核实复原的失败行动份额。 (b) 每个子类别在12个基准的所有Grasp失败中所占的份额。

blocks.en: Uneven Recovery Across Failure Modes. Frontier agents recover from most Incomplete motion , Grasp and Interference failures by the end of the episode, but from only one in three Alignment and Effect failures (Figure 7 (a)), and additional actions do not close this gap (Appendix C ). In these two modes the action reaches its target and fails on the final offset or on the physical effect of the contact. This shows that closed-loop recovery corrects failures of object acquisition and motion but leaves most precision-limited failures unresolved, indicating that spatial and contact precision remains essential for tight-tolerance manipulation.
blocks.zh: 失败模式下的不均匀复苏 。 边境特工在剧集结束前从大多数不完全运动,格拉斯普和干扰的失败中恢复过来,但只从三分之一的对齐和效果失败中恢复过来(图7(a)),额外的行动无法弥补这一差距(附录C). 在这两种模式中,动作达到目标,并在最后抵消或接触的物理效果上失败。 这表明闭路回收纠正了物体的获取和运动的失败,但大多数有限度的失败仍未解决,这表明空间和接触的精确度对于严格容忍操纵仍然至关重要.

blocks.en: 4.3 Fine-Grained Analysis of Grasp Failures
blocks.zh: 4.3 格拉斯普故障精细分析

blocks.en: Grasp is the most frequent failure mode in direct robot control (Figure 4 ). To locate the point at which a grasp fails, the critic assigns every Grasp failure a sub-category that records the contact error or the moment of loss. Figure 7 (b) reports their shares across all 12 benchmarks.
blocks.zh: Grasp是直接机器人控制中最常见的故障模式(图4). 为了找到抓取失败的点,评论家将每一次Grasp失败都指定一个子类,记录联系错误或损失的时刻. 图7(b)报告了它们在所有12个基准中的份额。

blocks.en: Grasps Fail at Closure. Three in five Grasp failures occur as the gripper closes, before the object is held, and only one in five occurs after capture. At closure, the gripper most frequently pinches only a rim, tip, or edge of the object, or closes beside or above it. In each of these cases the agent has selected the correct object and brought the gripper to it, and the grasp fails due to a small offset in depth or lateral position. This demonstrates that the grasping bottleneck of frontier agents is the fine 3D localization of the gripper relative to the object. Closure is also the leading stage on every benchmark with more than 100 Grasp failures (Appendix D ), indicating that higher spatial precision is the most direct path to more reliable direct robot control.
blocks.zh: 格拉斯失败关闭。 五分之三的格拉斯普故障发生于抓取器关闭时,在物体被持有之前,只有五分之一发生在捕获后. 关闭时,抓手最经常只捏住物体的边缘或边缘,或紧贴在物体的旁边或上面。 在每一种情况下,代理都选择了正确的对象,并将抓取器带给它,由于深度或横向位置的微小抵消,抓取失败. 这表明,边疆特工的瓶颈是比对物体的捕捉器精细的3D本地化。 关闭也是每个基准上超过100 Grassp故障(Appendix D )的领先阶段,表明更高的空间精度是更可靠的直接机器人控制的最直接路径.

blocks.en: Failures After Capture. Once an object is captured, handover and release account for only 1.5% of Grasp failures and most losses occur during carrying, showing that the remaining risk lies in transport. A further 9.5% of Grasp failures are actions issued with an already empty gripper, in which the agent continues to lift or carry an object it has lost. This shows that frontier agents can miss a lost object in their observations, and indicates that an action-level critic can serve as an online monitor that reports the loss at the action where it occurs.
blocks.zh: 捕捉失败 一旦一个物体被捕获,移交和释放只占格拉斯普故障的1.5%,大部分损失发生在携带过程中,这表明剩下的风险在于运输. 另外9.5%的Grasp故障是用已经空空的抓取器发布的动作,其中代理人继续升起或携带它失去的物体. 这表明边疆特工可能在观察中错过丢失的物体,并表明行动层面的批评者可以充当在线监视器,在出现损失时报告损失情况.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation of Action-Level Critics
blocks.zh: 5. 评价行动层面的批评

blocks.en: Table 1 : Action-level critic evaluation on the human-annotated test set. Outcome is scored on all actions and Failure Mode on the failed actions. Overall Accuracy requires both to be correct. Inference costs on the test set are reported in US dollars. Bold and underlined values mark the best and second-best results.
blocks.zh: 表1:行动层面的评委对人注解测试集的评价. 所有行动的结果都得分,失败模式则得分。 总体准确性要求两者都正确。 测试组的推论费用以美元报告。 大胆和强调的价值观标志着最佳和次佳的成果。

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate the reliability of action-level critics on our 400-action human-annotated test set. Human annotators label each action through a web-based annotation interface (Appendix E ), which shows the global task instruction, the local intent of the policy agent, and the pre-action, post-action and auxiliary lift frames. They independently label the outcome y t {y}_{t} of the action and, for a failed action, select its failure mode m t {m}_{t} from Figure 3 . Every critic receives the same input ( G , g t , 𝒪 t ) (G,g_{t},\mathcal{O}_{t}) as the human annotators. Table 1 reports accuracy and Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 11 ] for the action outcome on all 400 actions and for the failure mode on the 264 failed actions, together with Overall Accuracy, which requires both predictions to be correct.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价了行动层面批评者的可靠性,评价了我们400项行动人类附加说明的一套测试。 人类注释员通过一个基于网络的注释界面(Appendix E )来标注每个动作,该界面显示全球任务指示,政策代理人的局部意图,以及动作前,动作后和辅助提升帧. 他们独立标注动作的结果y t {y}_{t},对于失败的动作,从图3中选择它的失败模式m t {m}_{t}. 每个评论家得到的输入(G,g t,O t)(G,g_{t},\mathcal{O}_{t})与人类的注释者相同. 表1汇报了所有400项行动的行动结果和264项失败行动的失败模式的准确性和Cohen $\kappa[11],以及总体准确性,这要求两种预测都是正确的。

blocks.en: Human Evaluation of Annotated Data. We employ GPT-6 Astra as the critic for all action-level annotations analyzed in this paper and verify these annotations against human labels. GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest accuracy among all evaluated critics on the action outcome, the failure mode, and Overall Accuracy. The annotators further re-inspect every action on which GPT-6 Astra differs from their initial label. They accept its critique in most of these cases, which involve compound failures within a single action, such as a shallow closure ( Grasp ) that simultaneously tips the object away ( Alignment ), where the human annotator and the critic each identify one of the two valid failure modes. With the accepted critiques counted as correct, its agreement with the annotators exceeds 90% on both outcome and failure mode, demonstrating that GPT-6 Astra is a reliable critic for action-level analysis.
blocks.zh: 人类评价附加说明的数据。 我们利用GPT-6 Astra来批评本文分析的所有动作层面的说明,并对照人类的标签核实这些说明. GPT-6 Astra在动作结果,故障模式,以及总体准确性方面,在所有被评价的批评者中达到最高的准确度. 注释者进一步重新检查了GPT-6 Astra与其最初标签不同的每个动作. 他们接受其在大多数情况下的批评,这涉及单个行动中的复合失败,例如浅封闭(Grasp)同时将对象向外倾斜(对齐),其中人类注释者和评论者各自确定两种有效失败模式中的一个. 由于接受的批评被认为是正确的,它与注释者在结果和失败模式上的协议超过了90%,这表明GPT-6 Astra是行动层面分析的可靠批评者.

blocks.en: Ablation on Local Intent. We withhold the local intent g t g_{t} and give GPT-6 Astra only the task goal and the observations, i.e., 𝒞 ⁡ ( G , 𝒪 t ) \mathcal{C}(G,\mathcal{O}_{t}) . Both outcome accuracy and failure-mode accuracy drop sharply, to the lowest values in Table 1 . Without the local intent, GPT-6 Astra labels most actions unverifiable , since the same motion is an incomplete reach, a missed alignment, or a failed grasp depending on its intended result. This confirms that relying solely on the global goal leaves individual action evaluation ambiguous, preventing the critic from reliably determining action success. Local intent is therefore essential to make action-level critique well-posed.
blocks.zh: 在地方意图上滥用。 我们保留了本地意图 g t g_{t} 并只给 GPT-6 Astra 任务目标和观察, 即 C  (G, O t)\ mathcal{C} (G,\mathcal{O}_{t}) 。 结果精度和故障模式精度都急剧下降,降至表1中的最低值。 没有本地意图, GPT-6 Astra 标记了大多数无法验证的动作, 因为同一个运动是一个不完全的可及性, 错失对齐, 或失败的抓取, 取决于它的预期结果 。 这证实,仅仅依靠全球目标,个人行动评价就变得模糊不清,使批评者无法可靠地确定行动是否成功。 因此,当地的意图对于充分提出行动层面的批评至关重要。

blocks.en: Comparison of Critic Models. We compare GPT-6 Astra against five other proprietary models ( GPT-6.1 Sol [ 32 ] , GPT-6.1 Terra [ 33 ] , Claude Fable 5.2 [ 2 ] , Claude Opus 5.5 [ 3 ] , and Claude Sonnet 5.5 [ 4 ] ) and four open-source models (Kimi K3.1 Pro [ 28 ] , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 [ 13 ] , GLM-5.3-Flash [ 52 ] , and Muse-Glimmer-30B [ 1 ] ). The gap between GPT-6 Astra and every other proprietary model is larger on failure-mode accuracy than on outcome accuracy, and the open-source models without fine-tuning misidentify the failure mode of most failed actions. This demonstrates that judging the success of an action is within reach of current frontier models, while attributing a failure to its physical cause is the harder problem and the one that separates critics. Within both the GPT and Claude families, a higher model tier gives a more accurate critic, indicating that action-level critique benefits directly from stronger frontier models.
blocks.zh: 批判模型比较. 我们比较了GPT-6 Astra与其他5个专有型号(GPT-6.1 Sol [32],GPT-6.1 Terra [33],Claude Fable 5.2 [2],Claude Opus 5.5 [3],以及Claude Sonnet 5.5 [4])和4个开源型号. (Kimi K3.1 Pro [28],DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 [13],GLM-5.3-Flash [52],以及Muse-Glimer-30B). [1] 。 GPT-6 Astra和所有其他专有模型在故障模式精度上的差距大于结果精度上的差距,开源模型没有微调错误识别大多数失败动作的故障模式. 这表明,判断一项行动是否成功是当前前沿模式所能达到的,而将失败归咎于其实际原因则是更困难的问题,也是将批评者分开的问题。 在GPT和Claude两个家庭中,一个更高的模范级给出了更准确的批评,表明行动级批评直接受益于更强大的前沿模式.

blocks.en: Open-Source Critic VLM. To make action-level critique available without proprietary APIs, we fine-tune the open-source Muse-Glimmer-30B [ 1 ] on our dataset of 12,844 annotated actions, separated from the test set at the episode level. We provide training details in Appendix F . Fine-tuning raises its failure-mode accuracy from 32.58% to 74.24% and its Overall Accuracy from 34.75% to 67.75%. The fine-tuned critic outperforms every other open-source model on every metric, exceeds every proprietary model except GPT-6 Astra on failure-mode accuracy, and has the lowest inference cost among all critics, over 30 × 30\times lower than GPT-6 Astra. This demonstrates that the action-level critique of a frontier model transfers to an open-source VLM, enabling low-cost critique of large trajectory collections. Moreover, these results validate the effectiveness of our action-level critique dataset for training open-source critics competitive with frontier proprietary models.
blocks.zh: 开源批评VLM. 为了在无专有API的情况下提供动作层面的批评,我们微调了开源Muse-Glimer-30B[1]在我们12,844个注释动作的数据集上,从插曲层面的测试集中分离出来. 我们在附录F中提供了培训细节。 微调使其故障模式精度从32.58%提高到74.24%,其总体精度从34.75%提高到67.75%. 微调评论家在每一个公尺上都超越了其他开源模型,在故障模式精度上超过了除了GPT-6 Astra以外的每一个专有模型,在所有评论家中推论成本最低,比GPT-6 Astra低30×30\时. 这表明,对前沿模型的行动层面批评向开源VLM转移,从而能够对大型轨迹收集进行低成本批评。 此外,这些结果证实了我们为培训具有前沿专有模式的开放源码批评者而提出的行动层面批评数据集的有效性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control, enabled by AgentRoboCritic , an intent-grounded critique framework verified against human annotations.
Our analysis across 12 manipulation benchmarks demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation.
It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes.
We release our annotated dataset and a fine-tuned critic VLM to support future research on frontier agents as generalist robot policies via direct control.
blocks.zh:
由RoboCritic探员促成, 我们提出对直接机器人控制的前沿特工的系统行动分析,
我们对12项操纵基准的分析表明,边境人员的能力很有希望,包括从当地执行失败中进行闭路回收,在各种场景中进行可靠的语义定位,在没有针对具体任务的调整的情况下进行强烈的零射操纵。
报告也查明了目前存在的局限性,包括与任务有关的实际执行瓶颈,例如把握和调整,以及不同失败模式的复苏不平衡。
我们发布了我们附加说明的数据集和一个精细的批评家VLM,支持未来对前沿物剂的研究,作为通过直接控制实现的通用机器人政策.

blocks.zh: 附录

blocks.en: Appendix A Action-Level Failure Modes and Annotation Format
blocks.zh: 附录 A 动作级别失败模式和注释格式

blocks.en: We define the action-level failure modes and the grasp sub-categories used in the paper as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们定义了文件中使用的动作级失败模式和抓取子类如下.

blocks.en: For every failed action, the critic assigns one failure mode.
blocks.zh: 对于每个失败的动作,评论家都会指定一个失败模式.

blocks.en: Grasp . The object is not acquired or not retained, which defeats the local intent. For example, the bowl remains on the table during an intended lift.
blocks.zh: 格劳斯普。 该物体不获得或不保留,这破坏了当地的意图。 例如,碗在预定的升降机期间仍留在桌上.

blocks.en: Alignment . A held object or an intended contact misses its local target relation. For example, a plug stays beside its socket.
blocks.zh: 对齐. 持有的对象或预定联系人错过了本地目标关系。 例如,插头留在插座旁边。

blocks.en: Interference . Unintended motion, collision or displacement defeats the local intent. For example, an approaching forearm knocks over a neighboring stack.
blocks.zh: 干扰. 无意的运动、碰撞或迁移会挫败当地的意图。 例如,一个接近的前臂会敲过一个邻居的堆栈.

blocks.en: Effect . A tool stays under control but does not produce its stated effect. For example, a held scraping tool leaves the target unchanged despite contact.
blocks.zh: 影响. 一个工具仍然处于控制之中,但没有产生它宣称的效果. 例如,一个持有的刮刮工具尽管有接触但仍使目标保持不变。

blocks.en: Incomplete motion . A commanded movement, opening or reset remains incomplete and no more specific failure mode applies. Rejected executions and executions with an uncertain result are not Incomplete motion .
blocks.zh: 不完全运动。 受命移动,打开或重置仍未完成,不再适用更具体的故障模式. 拒绝处决和结果不确定的处决并不是不完全的动议。

blocks.en: Choice . The execution contradicts the object, order or category stated in the local intent. For example, pressing key 7 when the local intent requests key 3 is Choice , whereas pressing key 7 as the local intent requests is not, even when the task requires key 3.
blocks.zh: 选择. 执行与本地意图中声明的对象,命令或类别相矛盾. 例如,当本地意图请求键3时,按键7是选择,而按键7则不是,即使任务需要键3.

blocks.en: Unresolved . The action fails, but its failure mode cannot be established. An action with an unknown outcome is unverifiable , not Unresolved .
blocks.zh: 未解脱. 动作失败, 但其失败模式无法建立 。 未知结果的动作是不可核实的,而不是未解决的。

blocks.en:
The codebook in Appendix J gives a definition, an explanation, boundary rules and an example for each failure mode.
The boundary rules separate neighboring failure modes, for example Grasp for an object that is no longer held and Alignment for a held object that stays offset from its target, or Alignment for a tool that misses its contact target and Effect for a tool that makes contact without its stated effect.
blocks.zh:
附录J中的代码簿给出了定义,解释,边界规则以及每个失败模式的示例.
边界规则将邻接失败模式区分开来,例如Grasp用于不再持有的对象,对保持与目标相抵消的被持有对象进行对齐,或者对错过其接触目标的工具进行对齐,对没有说明效果的工具进行接触的效果。

blocks.en: In the release, partial is stored as partial_or_unconfirmed and failed as not_achieved . not applicable marks an entry that is not an executed action, and it is distinct from unverifiable , which marks an executed action whose result cannot be judged.
blocks.zh: 在发布时,部分被存储为部分_ 或_ 未确认, 失败为未实现 . 不适用的标记不是已执行的行动的条目, 它不同于不可验证的标记, 它标志着已执行的行动的结果无法判断 。

blocks.en:
Each Grasp failure receives a sub-category that describes the contact error or the moment of loss ( Table 2 ).
The sub-categories are grouped as in Figure 7 (b) into failures at closure, losses after capture, actions issued with an already empty gripper, and failed grasps whose contact cannot be resolved.
A sub-category is assigned only after the action is judged as failed.
blocks.zh:
每个Grasp故障都得到一个子类别,该子类别描述联系错误或损失时刻(表2 )。
如图7(b)所示,这些子类别分为关闭时的失败、捕获后的损失、用已经空的抓取器发出的动作以及无法解决其联系的失败抓取。
只有在行动被判定失败后才指定一个子类别。

blocks.en: Table 2: Grasp sub-categories and their stages. Figure 7 (b) combines the last four closure errors into other closure errors, the two carry losses into loss during carry, and failed transfers and releases into one category.
blocks.zh: 表2:格拉斯普亚类及其阶段. 图7(b) 将最后四个关闭错误合并为其他关闭错误,两者在结转期间将损失计入损失,未成功转移和释放为一类。

blocks.en:
For each action, the critic outputs the outcome, the failure mode, the grasp sub-category and a short reason.
The last three are empty when the action does not fail.

blocks.en: Appendix C Recovery Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录C 分析

blocks.en:
We present the recovery analysis behind panels (c) and (d) of Figure 5 .
We first define the analyzed failed actions and the criterion for a verified recovery, and show that the recovery rate is robust to the weighting of failures.
We then report recovery over later actions, by failure mode and in relation to task success.
Finally, we explain how recoveries are reviewed and list the statistics of every panel of Figure 5 for each benchmark.
blocks.zh:
我们提出图5(c)和(d)小组的回收分析。
我们首先确定分析失败的行动和经核实的恢复标准,并表明恢复率对失败的权重是强有力的。
然后,我们按失败模式和任务成功与否,报告以后行动的恢复情况。
最后,我们解释如何审查回收情况,并列出每个基准图5小组的统计数据。

blocks.en:
We analyze all 12,163 failed actions with an annotated failure mode in the 1,989 officially graded episodes that contain at least one, across the 12 benchmarks.
The reported shares give every failed action equal weight.
RoboDojo contributes 9,923 of the failed actions, and Table 4 lists every benchmark separately.
blocks.zh:
我们分析所有12,163个失败的动作,在1,989个正式分级的节目中带有附加说明的失败模式,其中至少包含一个,跨越12个基准.
上报的股票给每个失败的动作都同等分量.
RoboDojo为失败的动作贡献了9923个,表4分别列出每个基准.

blocks.en:
For each failed action, we follow the saved trajectory forward and record the first later action that shows a verified recovery.
A recovery is either a repair of the original sub-goal or progress along a different route that bypasses it.
After a missed grasp, a regrasp counts once the object visibly rises with the gripper.
In one trajectory, after failing to grasp a ball inside a cup, the agent grasps and lifts the cup with the ball inside, which prepares the pour and counts as a recovery along a different route.
A later action that only achieves its own stated intent, such as lifting an empty gripper after a missed grasp, does not count.
The sub-goal to be recovered is taken from the local intent of the failed action and the task instruction.
A regrasp of the same object with either hand restores possession, whereas placing the object on the table does not satisfy a required hand-to-hand transfer.
Each failed action is assessed separately, and when consecutive actions fail on the same sub-goal, such as two missed grasps of one object, the later action that achieves this sub-goal recovers both failures.
The distance to a recovery is the number of later actions up to and including the action that confirms it.
A recovery is counted even if the episode later fails.
Of the 12,163 failures, 6,435 are repaired directly and 589 are bypassed along a different route, and the remaining 5,139 are not recovered.
All 12,163 remain in the denominator, including the failures at the last action of an episode.
blocks.zh:
对于每一个失败的行动,我们沿着节省下来的轨道前进,并记录后来第一次显示经过核实的恢复的行动。
恢复要么是修复原先的次级目标,要么是沿着绕过它的不同路线取得进展。
在失去抓取后,一旦物体与抓取器一起明显上升,重力计数。
在一个轨迹中,在未能抓住杯内一个球后,代理抓住杯内并用球抬起杯子,这为灌注做准备,并算作沿着不同路线恢复.
仅仅实现自己明确意图的后期行动,如失手后举起空的抓手,不算数.
收回的次级目标来自失败行动的当地意图和任务指示。
用双手中的任何一只手对同一物体进行重采可以恢复占有,而将物体放在桌子上并不能满足要求的手对手转移.
每个失败的行动都单独评估,当连续行动在同一次级目标上失败时,例如错失了对一个目标的两个把握时,实现这一次级目标的后期行动会弥补两个失败.
恢复的距离是后来行动的数量,包括确认恢复的行动。
即使后来的剧集失败,恢复也是计算在内.
在12,163次故障中,有6,435次直接修复,589次绕行于不同的路线,其余的5,139次没有恢复.
所有12,163人仍然停留在分母中,包括一集最后一次行动失败.

blocks.en:
Giving every episode equal weight, by averaging the recovered share of failures within each episode, raises the share recovered by the end of the episode from 57.7% to 60.7%.
When only the first failed action of each episode is analyzed, 76.2% of these failures are recovered by the end of the episode.
This shows that the recovery rate holds under different weightings of failures.

blocks.en: Appendix G Qualitative Examples

blocks.en:
Figures 12 and 13 show annotated RoboDojo actions with full-width frames. Figure 12 follows two successful episodes, with one frame per action at the end of its execution and the critic’s outcome.
In the first, the agent closes in front of the block, reopens, shifts back and closes on it, and then lifts and carries it, which illustrates closed-loop recovery ( Section 4.1 ).
In the second, every pressed button matches the count and order stated in the first local intent, which demonstrates semantic grounding ( Section 4.1 ). Figure 13 follows single failed actions over time, together with the critic’s failure reason.
The two Grasp failures are losses after capture, during the first lift and during carrying ( Section 4.3 ), and the Alignment failure releases a mug whose handle misses the peg.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: Appendix H Additional Results on Direct Robot Control
blocks.zh: 附录H 直接机器人控制的附加结果

blocks.en:
We report additional experiments with GPT-6 Astra as the policy.
They cover policy refinement with critic feedback ( Section H.1 ), the effect of local intent on task success ( Section H.2 ), the zero-shot comparison on more tasks ( Section H.3 ) and inference latency ( Section H.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们以GPT-6 Astra作为政策报告其他实验。
它们包括有批评者反馈的政策改进(H.1节)、当地意图对任务成功的影响(H.2节)、对更多任务的零镜头比较(H.3节)和推断延迟(H.4节)。

blocks.en: H.1 Action-Level Critic Guides Policy Refinement
blocks.zh: H.1 行动层面的批评指南

blocks.en:
We investigate whether the action-level critique of a failed episode can guide the same policy on a new attempt.
On the Standard instance i00 of the DexJoCo water-plant task, the original GPT-6 Astra episode timed out without success.
We run two new attempts with the same frozen policy at high reasoning effort, the same seed and the same initial state.
Both attempts receive the task instruction, a notice that the previous attempt failed and three local intents from that attempt.
The feedback attempt also receives the critic’s assessment of these three actions ( Figure 14 ), and the control attempt does not. Table 11 lists the three runs, and Figure 15 shows frames of the two new attempts.
The control attempt pulls the trigger while the bottle points away from the plant and fails, and the feedback attempt completes the task.
The first critique reports that the nozzle still faced away from the plant after the turn ( Alignment ), and the last local intent of the successful attempt is to push the rigid neck toward the plant so that the nozzle comes into range.
This case shows that action-level critiques can be returned to a frontier agent as feedback for its next attempt.
blocks.zh:
我们调查一下,对失败事件的行动层面批评是否能够在新的尝试中指导同样的政策。
在DexJoCo水厂任务的标准例i00上,最初的GPT-6 Astra插曲超时,没有成功.
我们用同样的冻结政策 进行了两次新的尝试 在高推理努力, 同样的种子和相同的初始状态。
两次尝试都收到任务指示,一次是前一次尝试失败的通知,三次是当地意图。
反馈尝试也收到批评者对这三项行动的评价(图14),控制尝试没有. 表11列出了这三项尝试,图15显示了两项新尝试的框架。
控制尝试在瓶子指向远离工厂并失败时扣动扳机,反馈尝试完成任务.
第一个批评者报告说,喷嘴在转弯(对齐)后仍面临远离工厂的情况,成功尝试的最后局部意图是将刚性脖子推向工厂,以便喷嘴进入范围.
此案表明,行动层面的批评可以退回边境代理人,作为下一次尝试的反馈。

blocks.en: H.2 Effect of Local Intent on Task Success
blocks.zh: H.2 地方意图对任务成功的影响

blocks.en:
Our policy rollouts require a local intent alongside every action ( Section 3.2 ).
We investigate whether this requirement changes task performance by comparing our GPT-6 Astra episodes with the official GPT-6 Astra runs published by the Embodied First Exam, which do not require a local intent, on the 76 Standard instances that both cover.
GPT-6 Astra succeeds on 42 of the 76 instances (55.3%) both with and without the local intent requirement.
This shows that stating a local intent alongside every action has little effect on the success rate of GPT-6 Astra, and that the local intents that AgentRoboCritic relies on come at little cost to policy performance.
blocks.zh:
我们的政策推出需要地方意向,同时采取每一项行动(第3.2节)。
我们调查这一要求是否改变任务性能,将我们的GPT-6 Astra事件与Embody First Exam发布的正式的GPT-6 Astra事件相比较,后者不需要本地意向,两者都涵盖76个标准例。
GPT-6 Astra在76例中,有42例成功(55.3%),无论有无当地意图要求。
这表明,在每项行动的同时说明当地意图对GPT-6 Astra的成功率影响不大,而RoboCritic探员所依赖的当地意图对政策业绩来说成本很小。

blocks.en: H.3 Zero-Shot Comparison on More Tasks
blocks.zh: H.3 更多任务的零热度比较

blocks.en:
We extend the zero-shot comparison of Figure 6 to matched tasks from five suites of the Embodied First Exam, on which both GPT-6 Astra and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} have a scored episode.
Both policies run each task instance without task-specific fine-tuning or demonstrations, and the grader of each benchmark scores the episode. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} sends a low-level action to the simulator after every observation, and GPT-6 Astra issues numerical actions through tool calls ( Section 3.1 ). Figure 16 shows the success rates of both policies.
GPT-6 Astra outperforms π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on every suite, and every task that π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} completes is also completed by GPT-6 Astra.
This further supports the zero-shot advantage of frontier agents shown in Figure 6 .

这两项政策都运行每个任务实例,但没有针对具体任务的微调或演示,每个基准的分级员对插曲进行评分. ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5}每次观察后都会向模拟器发送低级动作,GPT-6 Astra通过工具调用发布数字动作(第3.1节). 图16显示了这两项政策的成功率。
GPT-6 Astra在每套套房的成绩都超过了 ~ 0.5\pi_{0.5},完成的每个任务也由 GPT-6 Astra 完成.
这进一步支持图6所示的边境特工的零射出优势.

blocks.en: H.4 Inference Latency
blocks.zh: H.4 推断延迟

blocks.en:
We measure the decision latency of GPT-6 Astra and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on the tasks of the zero-shot comparison ( Figure 6 ) and on further matched tasks of the Embodied First Exam suites.
A latency interval runs from the completion of the most recent observation request to the start of the next executed action submission, both read from the journal of the robot service.
Read-only tool calls inside the interval are included, and intervals across resets or episodes and actions that are not executed are excluded.
For each run we take the median interval, and Table 12 reports the median and interquartile range of these run medians over the tasks timed for both policies.
Across 74 matched tasks, the median decision takes 31.9 s for GPT-6 Astra and 0.11 s for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and the gap is similar on RoboTwin 2.0 and YAMLab.

blocks.en: Appendix I Verification Against Critic Self-Preference Bias
blocks.zh: 附录一 反对批评性自我偏爱的核查

blocks.en:
GPT-6 Astra serves as both the control policy and the primary critic in our study.
We therefore examine whether using the same model introduces self-preference bias, and whether fine-tuning on our dataset transfers such bias to the open-source critic.
blocks.zh:
GPT-6 Astra既是控制政策,也是我们研究的主要批评者。
因此,我们审查使用同一模型是否引入自我偏好,以及我们数据集的微调是否将这种偏好转移给开源评论家。

blocks.en:
A critic biased toward its own policy would systematically label failed actions as achieved . Table 13 counts these errors for each critic on the human-annotated test set.
GPT-6 Astra labels only 19 of the 264 human-labeled failed actions as achieved , the fewest among all evaluated critics.
Claude Fable 5.2, a frontier model from a different model family, reaches a similar outcome accuracy of 78.25%, compared to 79.25% for GPT-6 Astra ( Table 1 ).
This shows that GPT-6 Astra is the strictest evaluator of its own failed actions, and that the high agreement with human labels holds across model families.
blocks.zh:
一个对自身政策持偏见的批评者会系统地将失败的行动标榜为已经实现的。 表13将每个评论家的这些错误计入了人类附加说明的测试集.
GPT-6 Astra只标注了264个人类标注失败行动中的19个,
Claude Fable 5.2是一个来自不同模型家族的前沿模型,其结果精度达到78.25%,而GPT-6 Astra为79.25%(表1)。
这表明GPT-6 Astra是对自己失败的动作进行最严格的评价,与人类标签的高度一致贯穿于模范家庭.

blocks.en: Table 13: Failed actions labeled achieved by each critic, out of the 264 actions that the annotators judge as failed in the human-annotated test set.
blocks.zh: 表13:在注解者评为人为注解测试集失败的264项行动中,每个评论家标注实现的失败行动.

blocks.en:
Muse-Glimmer-30B is fine-tuned on our dataset of actions annotated by GPT-6 Astra and scored against the human labels, on test episodes that are kept out of training ( Sections 5 and F ).
Fine-tuning halves the failed actions that it labels as achieved ( Table 13 ) and raises its failure-mode accuracy above every critic except GPT-6 Astra ( Table 1 ).
This shows that fine-tuning on our dataset makes the critic stricter on failed actions and more accurate on the human-annotated benchmark.
blocks.zh:
Muse-Glimer-30B对GPT-6 Astra附加说明的我们的行动数据集进行了微调,并在不经过训练的试验中与人类标签相对应得分(第5节和第F节)。
微调将其标注为已实现的失败动作减半(表13),并将其失败模式精度提升到除GPT-6 Astra(表1)以外的每个评论家之上.
这表明,对我们的数据集进行微调,使批评者更严格地对待失败的行动,更准确地对待人为附加说明的基准。

blocks.en: Appendix J Critic Codebook
blocks.zh: 附录 J 批评码本

blocks.en:
The codebook below follows the system prompt of Figure 8 in every critic request.
It gives a label, a definition, an explanation, a boundary rule and an example for each failure mode, and a label and a definition for each Grasp sub-category. Table 14 lists the names used in this paper for its identifiers.
blocks.zh:
下面的代码册遵循每个评论者请求中图8的系统提示.
它给出了每个故障模式的标签,定义,解释,边界规则和实例,以及每个格拉斯普子类的标签和定义. 表14列出了本文件中用于识别特征的名称。

blocks.en: Codebook M1 Acquisition / retention. Definition. The required object is not captured, is lost, or is already absent from the manipulating hand. Explanation. Use when the current local manipulation fails because the required object is not captured, slips out, is dislodged, or was already absent from the hand before the call. Identify the object, arm, contact geometry, and stage of loss to the extent supported by the images. Boundary. Add an S1-S14 subcategory. Distinguish a new loss from an already-empty follow-up (S11), and retain S12 when non-retention is visible but the contact error is not. A deliberate release or a successful diagnostic test is not automatically an M1 failure. An object still held but offset from its target is usually M2. Example. The note asks to grasp the coin, but the jaws close above its top and the subsequent lift leaves it on the table: M1 with S1. M2 Targeting / engagement. Definition. A held object or commanded contact remains offset, tilted, or outside its intended target. Explanation. Use when a held object or intended contact misses the current local target because it remains offset, misoriented, too shallow, or outside the intended contact region. Describe the visible target relation rather than attributing the error to an unobserved controller or perception defect. Boundary. The immediate problem is targeting or engagement, not missing possession (M1). A major unintended excursion or collision can be M3. If contact is established but the intended tool effect is absent, consider M4. A small intermediate approach is not a failed insertion unless insertion was the current stated goal. Example. The note requests inserting the retained plug, but the plug tip stays beside the socket opening at the end of the call. M3 Motion / interference. Definition. The current call causes a major unintended excursion, collision, or object displacement. Explanation. Use when the current call produces a major unintended motion, collision, or displacement that defeats its local goal. Record which hand or object moved, what it contacted, and the unwanted change; do not label every incidental touch a collision failure. Boundary. An ordinary positional miss can be M2. When closure pushes the intended object away and thereby prevents capture, the more specific acquisition description is M1/S4. A later call should not inherit M3 solely because an earlier call disturbed the scene. Example. During a requested approach, the forearm strikes a neighboring stack and knocks several blocks off their supports. M4 Task-effect failure. Definition. A retained tool/object fails to produce its intended pour, strike, or other task effect. Explanation. Use when the relevant object or tool remains retained but the call does not produce its stated physical effect, such as a pour, strike, scrape, or target-state change. Identify the absent effect and the visible interaction that supports the judgment. Boundary. If the hand is empty, use M1. If the tool visibly misses its contact target, M2 may be the more specific mechanism. If the requested movement or opening itself never completes, consider M5. Do not infer an absent effect that the released observations cannot show. Example. The hand retains the container and executes the intended tilt, but no contents enter the receiving bowl despite the note requesting a pour into it. M5 Incomplete motion / reset. Definition. A movement, opening, withdrawal, or return is incomplete without a more specific mechanism. Explanation. Use when a requested movement, opening, withdrawal, reset, or return remains incomplete and no more specific acquisition, targeting, interference, or task-effect mechanism is supported. Describe the commanded change and the visible residual state. Boundary. This code requires a demonstrably unachieved local goal; an intentionally incremental movement or a truncated, unobservable result may instead be partial/unconfirmed or unverifiable. Rejected commands are not executed-action M5 failures. Do not infer why the mechanism failed to move. Example. The note requests opening the gripper and releasing the object, but the fingers remain closed and the object remains clamped at the supported endpoint. M6 Unresolved mechanism. Definition. The local goal fails, but the available evidence does not identify a more specific mechanism. Explanation. Use when the current local goal is demonstrably not achieved but the available evidence does not identify a more specific action mechanism. State the failed local result, identify the missing or occluded evidence, and avoid choosing a visually unsupported mechanical explanation. Boundary. M6 is different from an unverifiable outcome: failure itself must be supported. If non-retention is established but its contact geometry is unclear, use M1/S12 rather than M6. A missing original note is not by itself evidence of a failed local goal. Example. The visible local target state is unchanged after an intended manipulation, but the relevant interaction is occluded and the evidence cannot distinguish incomplete motion from a failed task effect. M7 Wrong local choice. Definition. The stated local selection or relation itself is unsuccessful; a separate task mismatch is not sufficient. Explanation. Use when the call fails its own stated selection, ordering, or categorical-relation goal. The identifying issue is which object, answer, or relation was enacted, even if the low-level movement completed normally. The original local note and the relevant reference must support that discrepancy. Boundary. A mismatch with the overall task is not sufficient if the action faithfully executes its own note; this does not by itself establish a failed local action. Distinguish choosing the wrong named target from a continuous targeting miss (M2). M7 remains unassessed in the preserved RoboDojo-Precision baseline. Example. The note requests pressing the key labeled 3, but the robot presses the clearly labeled 7 key. If the note itself requests 7 and the robot presses 7, that is not M7 merely because the overall task required 3. S1 Jaws close above object. Fingers close over the top rather than around the body; a vertical miss must be visible. S2 Jaws close beside / ahead / behind. The object is outside the opposing jaw gap; record the visible lateral or depth offset. S3 Only rim / tip / edge pinched. Only a shallow rim, tip, edge, or tapered surface is caught; name the contact region. S4 Closure pushes / tips object away. The acquiring hand pushes, rolls, or tips the object instead of enclosing it. S5 Support / another object caught. A rest, fixture, support, or other object is caught instead of the intended target. S6 Receiving hand misses transfer. The receiving jaws fail to secure the transferred object; donor timing is not assumed. S7 Slip during initial lift. After transient capture, the object separates during the first lift; it did leave its support. S8 Slip during carry / wrist turn. An object that previously moved with the hand separates during carrying or turning. S9 Contact pulls object out. Visible contact with a surface, target, obstacle, or other arm dislodges a held object. S10 Opening before support. The gripper opens before a secure support is established and the object falls. S11 Already-empty follow-up motion. The hand was already empty before this call; it is a downstream motion, not a new loss. S12 Contact error not visible. Non-retention is established, but offset, shallow contact, and transient slip cannot be resolved. S13 Wrong jaw faces / axis. The jaw orientation visibly fails to oppose the faces or axis that must be pinched. S14 Inside-hole nut grasp fails. Visible contact inside a nut bore fails to lift the nut; internal contact must be observed.
blocks.zh: 代码簿 M1 获取/保留. 定义。 所需要的对象没有被捕获,丢失,或者已经不在操纵手中. 解释. 在当前局部操纵失败时使用,因为所需的对象没有被捕获,滑出,被驱离,或者在呼叫前已经从手中消失. 识别物体、臂、接触几何和损失的阶段,其程度由图像支持。 边界。 增加一个S1-S14子类. 区分新损失与已空后续(S11),当非保留可见但联系错误不是时保留S12. 故意释放或成功诊断试验并非M1自动失效. 仍然持有但与其目标相抵消的物体通常为M2. 示例. 纸币要求抓住硬币,但下巴靠近其顶部,随后的升力将其留在桌上: M1与S1. M2 目标/接触。 定义。 持有的物体或命令的接触仍为抵消、倾斜或超出预定目标。 解释. 当一个持有的物体或预定的接触者错过了当前局部目标时使用,因为它仍然被抵消,方向错误,太浅,或者在预定的接触区域之外. 描述可见的目标关系,而不是将错误归结为未观察到的控制器或感知缺陷. 边界。 眼下的问题是瞄准目标或参与,而不是丢失财产(M1)。 一次重大的意外外游或碰撞可以是M3. 如果建立了联系,但没有预期的工具效果,请考虑M4。 除非插入是目前宣布的目标,否则小型中间办法不是失败的插入。 实例。 音符要求插入保留插头,但插头端端端的插头开口处保留. M3运动/干扰. 定义。 目前的呼声造成重大的意外外出、碰撞或物体转移。 解释. 当当前呼叫产生重大意外运动、碰撞或迁移,使其局部目标落空时使用。 记录哪个手或物体移动,它联系到什么,以及不想要的改变;不要将每次偶然触碰碰撞失败都贴上标签。 边界。 普通位置误差可以是M2. 当关闭将预定对象推开从而阻止捕获时,更具体的获取描述是M1/S4. 之后的电话不应该仅仅因为早先的电话扰乱了现场而继承M3. 实例。 在要求的方法中,前臂击中了邻居的堆栈,并敲断了几个街区的支撑. M4 任务效果失败 。 定义。 保留的工具/对象未能产生预期的倾注、打击或其他任务效果。 解释. 当相关物体或工具仍然保留,但调用未产生其声明的物理效果时使用,如倾斜、打击、刮刮或目标状态变化。 识别不存在的效果以及支持判断的可见互动. 边界。 如果手是空的,请使用M1. 如果该工具明显未能达到接触目标,M2可能是更为具体的机制。 如果请求的移动或打开本身从未完成,则考虑M5. 不要推断所发表的观察无法显示的无效效果。 实例。 手保留容器并执行预定的倾斜,但尽管有纸条要求倒入,没有内装物进入接收碗. M5不完全运动/重置. 定义。 如果没有更具体的机制,运动、开放、撤出或返回是不完整的。 解释. 当请求的移动、打开、撤回、重置或返回仍然不完整,并且不支持更具体的获取、瞄准、干扰或任务影响机制时使用。 描述指令的变化和可见的剩余状态. 边界。 这个守则要求有一个明显没有实现的地方目标;有意的递增运动或短短的,不可观察的结果可能反而是部分的/未经确认的或无法核实的. 拒绝的命令不是执行动作 M5 失败 。 不要推断为什么机制未能移动 。 实例。 注释要求打开抓取器并释放物体,但手指仍然闭合,物体仍然被夹在支持的终点. M6 未解机制. 定义。 地方目标失败,但现有证据没有确定更具体的机制。 解释. 当目前的地方目标显然没有实现时使用,但现有证据没有确定更具体的行动机制。 描述失败的本地结果, 识别缺失或隐蔽的证据, 并避免选择无法显示的机械解释 。 边界。 M6不同于不可核实的结果:失败本身必须得到支持. 如果非保留被确定但联系几何不清,则使用M1/S12而不是M6. 缺失的原始音符本身并不是当地目标失败的证据. 实例。 可见的局部目标状态在有意操纵后保持不变,但相关互动被占用,证据无法区分不完全运动和失败的任务效果. M7错误的本地选择. 定义。 说明的本地选择或关系本身是不成功的;单独的任务不匹配是不够的。 解释. 调用失败时使用它自己声明的选择,命令,或绝对关系目标. 识别问题在于,即使低级运动正常完成,还是制定了哪一个对象、答案或关系。 当地原始说明和相关参考必须支持这种差异。 边界。 如果动作忠实地执行自己的音符,那么与总体任务不匹配是不够的;这本身并不能建立失败的地方行动. 区分选择错误的命名目标与连续目标错(M2). M7仍未在保留下来的RoboDojo精密度基线中进行评估。 实例。 音符要求按下标有3的密钥,但机器人按下明显标有7的密钥. 如果说明本身要求7,机器人按7,那就不是M7,仅仅因为需要完成总体任务 3个 靠近物体的S1大Jaws. 手指紧靠顶部而不是身体周围;垂直误差必须可见. S2大牙紧靠在后面 物体位于对立的下颚间隙之外;记录可见的横向或深度偏移. S3 只有边缘 / 尖端 / 边缘 夹住 。 只捕捉到浅边、尖端、边缘或带状表面; 命名接触区。 S4 关闭将/提示对象推开. 获取的手推、滚、 或提示对象, 而不是附着它。 S5 支持 / 另一个对象被捕获 。 休息、固定、支持或其他物体被捕获,而不是预定目标。 S6接收手丢失传输. 接收的下巴不能保证被转移对象的安全;捐助者的时间不假定。 初升时S7滑动. 瞬间捕获后,物体在第一次升降时分离;它确实留下了它的支撑. S8 携带/腕转时滑动. 之前携带或转动时随手移动的物体。 S9 联系人拔出对象 。 与表面、目标、障碍物或其他臂的明显接触使被持有物体消散。 第10号 支持前开放。 抓取器在安全支持建立和对象下降之前打开. S11已经空洞无物的后续动议. 在此之前,这只手已经是空的;这是一个下游运动,而不是新的损失。 第12条 联系人错误不可见 。 非保留成立,但抵消,浅接触,瞬间滑动无法解决. 第13条 下巴脸/轴错. 下巴方向显然不能反对必须夹住的面部或轴。 S14 内洞坚果抓断失败. 坚果熊体内的可见接触未能提升坚果;必须观察到内部接触。
